name: pokemon-buddy
description: One random animated Pokémon above your prompt, new each session: a Mystery Dungeon style buddy that walks the band and acts with character, or a Game Boy Color style sprite from Pokémon Crystal

style.title: Style
style.description: Sky: a Mystery Dungeon style Pokémon from PMDCollab/SpriteCollab that walks the band and acts with character (needs curl). Crystal: a Game Boy Color style sprite at the right end, from the three Crystal sources below.

crystal.title: Pokémon Crystal sprites
crystal.description: The original Pokémon Crystal sprites (#1 to #251), from PokeAPI/sprites.

polishedCrystal.title: Polished Crystal sprites
polishedCrystal.description: Later relatives and regional forms in Crystal's style, from the Polished Crystal ROM hack.

prism.title: Pokémon Prism sprites
prism.description: Gen 3 and 4 Pokémon in Crystal's style, from a third-party archive of graphics extracted from Pokémon Prism. See NOTICE.md.
